title: Baidu Trending Searches Scraper
description: Track Baidu trending searches with topic text, rank, descriptions, and source links. Choose a trending board and collect a fresh batch of topics to monitor search interest in China.

batch.title: Trending boards
batch.description: Baidu trending board names to collect.
batch.valueDescription: tab used to run this search.

trending_searches.title: Portable air conditioners
trending_searches.description: Search interest is rising for compact cooling options for apartments and home offices.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Track Baidu trending boards with ranked topics and source links. Monitor emerging search interest in China and export topics for market analysis.
storeCopy.intro: Read current topics from selected Baidu trending boards. Each row includes rank, topic text, a result title and link, and the board indicator when available.
useCases: Trend analysts can spot rising topics by board and rank.
Editors can use current Baidu topics to plan local news and content calendars.
Market teams can track changing interest around products and public topics.
howToUse: Add one Baidu trending board name to `tabs` for each board.
Set `maxResults` to cap topic rows saved.
Run the Actor and review topic, title, position, and link fields.

faqs.question: Which trending boards can I request?
faqs.answer: Use a board value supported by the source, such as `realtime`; rows reflect the topics currently available.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Rank of this topic on the selected Baidu trending board.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Search phrase or topic currently trending on Baidu.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Headline shown for this Baidu trend, when the board provides one.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Baidu page linked from the trending topic.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short context or summary shown alongside the trend.

fields.name: is_top
fields.description: True when Baidu marks the topic as a leading trend.

fields.name: input_tab
fields.description: Baidu trending board selected for this collection.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this trending topic was collected.
